method: Real workspace UI and validation scripts, explicit mocked Chrome API fixtures on about:blank. No installed-extension behavior or OS window movement is proven.

tests.name: Workspace empty state renders with clear limits and no auto-open
Four existing pages can be selected for move-without-reload adoption
New workspace only reports saved after it has been saved
Edits made after saving remain bound to the live draft and persist on a second save
Page reorder/removal updates layout order and available page choices
Changing a selected home URL drops the stale live-tab adoption binding
All five layout controls update the explicitly labelled arrangement preview
Destination selection survives editing and routing/focus are independent preferences
Open and arrange-only requests carry stable identities and distinct reopen intent
Pause/resume and explicit release preserve the saved definition
Invalid workspace imports show a validation error without adding definitions
Prototype-like workspace identities are rejected by the actual import schema
Optional display access is requested from the user gesture and populates monitor choices
Interrupted operations require explicit acknowledgement before retry
Untrusted page labels render as text, not executable markup
Saving unrelated page edits does not clear a browsing window created since the editor opened
Workspace UI renders at 390/768/1280px without horizontal overflow; capture labelled demo screens
No uncaught JavaScript errors occurred in the rendered workspace UI
